verdict.rationale: ReadMe's Versions docs say you can maintain more than one version of your docs, with version settings and a reader-facing dropdown for switching versions on the hub. Multi-product separation is only implied: Enterprise lets you group several projects into a single portal. Missing for 10: explicit per-product versioning (beyond separate projects in an Enterprise group), documented linkage between doc versions and API definition versions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the version switcher.
